comments.body:
I'm not sure I'm following; how would it be `undefined`? It has a default value, so even if we didn't pass any of them, it would use those values.
Can't we just re-add `Object.assign`?

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
> I'm not sure I'm following; how would it be undefined? It has a default value, so even if we didn't pass any of them, it would use those values.

Yes, it has a default value, `{ depth: 2, clobber: false }`. 
But if you pass a partial value when calling, like `assignWithDepth(..,.., { depth: 2 })`, that default value will not be used, so, the config will have the value `{ depth: 2 }`. Which makes `clobber` undefined. 

In short, the default value is not "merged" with the passed value, but it's used only if there is no passed value. 

We have to use the format in my suggestion to put default values into individual properties, essentially imitating merge.

It is not necessary to put the values in two places. 

```ts

```
